source_notes: Baseline and platform are recorded in initial_results.json; these are the exact extended experiment sources.

sources.BUILD.bazel:
load("@aspect_rules_py//py:defs.bzl", "py_binary", "py_library", py_test = "py_pytest_test")

py_library(
    name = "algorithm",
    srcs = ["algorithm.py"],
    deps = ["//operation_graph_optimization/complete:graph"],
)

py_binary(
    name = "benchmark",
    srcs = ["benchmark.py"],
    deps = [
        ":experiment",
        ":snapshot",
        "//operation_graph_optimization:combination_algorithm",
        "//operation_graph_optimization:combination_inputs",
        "//operation_graph_optimization/complete:graph",
        "@pypi//click",
    ],
)

py_library(
    name = "experiment",
    srcs = ["experiment.py"],
    deps = [
        ":algorithm",
        ":snapshot",
        "//operation_graph_optimization:algorithm",
        "//operation_graph_optimization:combination_inputs",
        "//operation_graph_optimization:complete_inputs",
        "//operation_graph_optimization:integrated_workloads",
        "//operation_graph_optimization:vanish_workloads",
        "//operation_graph_optimization/complete:algorithm",
    ],
)

py_library(
    name = "snapshot",
    srcs = ["snapshot.py"],
    deps = [
        ":algorithm",
        "//operation_graph_optimization/complete:graph",
    ],
)

py_test(
    name = "model_integration_test",
    size = "small",
    srcs = ["model_integration_test.py"],
    data = ["//:pyproject.toml"],
    deps = [
        ":experiment",
        "//operation_graph_optimization:algorithm",
        "//operation_graph_optimization:vanish_workloads",
        "@define//define/compiler:driver",
        "@pypi//coverage",
        "@pypi//pytest",
    ],
)
